To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) a single FCN can perform extremely well for object detection and 2) incorporating with landmark localization can improve the performance of object detection.

(1) a single FCN can detect multiple different kinds of objects accurately and efficiently; (2) when incorporating with landmark prediction, DenseBox further improve the detection accuracy; (3) DenseBox is the first end-to-end FCNN for object detection.

DenseBox is a unified end-to end FCN framework that can directly predict bounding boxes and object classes through all locations and sizes of an image, and it achieves state-of-the-art performance for challenging object detection tasks such as face detection and car detection.

two questions: 1) how to build an accurate and fast FCN for object detection; and 2) how to incorporate landmark localization with object detection.
